summary: The findings indicate a pattern of brute force attempts followed by a successful login and subsequent sudo activity.

attack_chain.explanation: Multiple failed login attempts from the same IP address (10.0.5.23) within a short period of time.
A successful login from the same IP address (10.0.5.23) to the root account.
The user root performed sudo activity within 10 minutes of the successful login.

mitigations: Implement account lockout policies to prevent brute force attacks.
Monitor sudo activity and enforce strict sudo rules to prevent privilege escalation.
Review and update sudoers file to restrict sudo privileges as necessary.
